name: Control two pans at once
short_description: Control two pans at once once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can control two pans at once in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Control two pans at once means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Control two pans at once in a fresh real-life scenario.
